description.en: Scan the repository for checked-in secrets

instructions.de: Scanne das Projekt-Repository nach eingecheckten Secrets. Variablen: tool (gitleaks/trufflehog).
instructions.en: Scan the project repository for checked-in secrets. Variables: tool (gitleaks/trufflehog).

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
TOOL="{{ tool }}"
echo "=== Secret Scan ($(pwd)) ==="
if [ "$TOOL" = "gitleaks" ]; then
  gitleaks detect --source . --report-format json --report-path .gitleaks-report.json 2>&1 && echo "No secrets found." || echo "Potential secrets detected!"
elif [ "$TOOL" = "trufflehog" ]; then
  trufflehog filesystem --json . > .trufflehog-report.json 2>&1 || true
  FINDINGS=$(wc -l < .trufflehog-report.json)
  echo "Findings: $FINDINGS"
else
  echo "Unsupported tool: $TOOL (use gitleaks or trufflehog)" && exit 1
fi

config.condition: TOOL="{{ tool }}"; if [ "$TOOL" = "gitleaks" ]; then [ -f .gitleaks-report.json ] && python3 -c "import json; f=json.load(open('.gitleaks-report.json')); exit(0 if len(f)>0 else 1)"; elif [ "$TOOL" = "trufflehog" ]; then [ -f .trufflehog-report.json ] && [ -s .trufflehog-report.json ]; else exit 1; fi
config.then_command: echo "WARNING: Secrets found! Review the report below."

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
TOOL="{{ tool }}"
echo "# Secret Scan Report"
echo "Generated: $(date -Iseconds)"
echo "Project: $(pwd)"
echo "Tool: $TOOL"
echo ""
if [ "$TOOL" = "gitleaks" ] && [ -f .gitleaks-report.json ]; then
  COUNT=$(python3 -c "import json; print(len(json.load(open('.gitleaks-report.json'))))" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  echo "Findings: $COUNT"
  if [ "$COUNT" != "0" ]; then
    python3 -c "
import json
for f in json.load(open('.gitleaks-report.json')):
    print(f'- {f.get(\"RuleID\",\"unknown\")}: {f.get(\"File\",\"?\")}:{f.get(\"StartLine\",\"?\")}')" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
elif [ "$TOOL" = "trufflehog" ] && [ -f .trufflehog-report.json ]; then
  LINES=$(wc -l < .trufflehog-report.json)
  echo "Findings: $LINES"
fi
rm -f .gitleaks-report.json .trufflehog-report.json
